stem.text: X-ray analysis of fossilised cells found in rocks in central India dating back 1.6 billion years has revealed several features.

items: The cells are up to $145\,\mu\text{m}$ long.
The cells are joined end to end to form filaments.
The cells contain some internal cell structures.
The cells are surrounded by a cell wall.

stem.text: Which two features, when taken together, provide most support for the conclusion that the cells are plant cells?
